verdict.rationale: Pipecat publishes an API reference section (e.g., the CLI and context-hub pages). Its context-hub builds a local index of docs, examples and API for coding agents to query, and the quickstart provides a runnable starter bot. However, nothing shows an interactive API reference with in-page runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec to power a try-it console. Missing for 10: an interactive, explorable API reference, runnable or try-it examples embedded in the reference, and independent corroboration.
